artworks.title: Daniel Heinsius
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Jacob Fransz van der Merck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, seated. The man has wavy shoulder-length hair, a prominent nose, expressive eyes, and wears a dark garment with a white collar. He has a chain with a medallion around his neck, showing status. The background features an oval frame with decorative text, set against a plain background. Latin text is inscribed below the portrait within the border.

artworks.title: Hendrick de Keyser
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Thomas de Keyser
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man in a bust portrait within an ornate oval frame. The man has a serious expression with prominent facial features, curly hair, a full beard, and a mustache. He is dressed in period clothing, and the frame is intricately decorated. Text inscriptions surround the frame and are below the portrait, likely providing information about the subject.

artworks.title: Adriaen Heereboord
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to his left, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has a broad forehead, arched eyebrows, a prominent nose, a small moustache, dark curly hair that falls to about ear length, and is wearing a dark coat buttoned up the front with a large white collar. The man is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with text along its inner edge, and the background has a textured pattern with no distinct objects or scenery. There are inscriptions and text beneath the oval in a classical font.

artworks.title: Lodewijk de Dieu
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed portrait of a man facing slightly to his left. He has short brown hair and a full beard with defined facial features including a straight nose. He is clothed in a dark, fur-lined garment with a white ruff collar. There are Latin inscriptions in the oval frame surrounding the portrait and more text below the image. The background is textured and dark.

artworks.title: Daniel Heinsius
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Jacob Fransz van der Merck
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait print of a man's upper body in a three-quarter view facing towards his right side. He has a mature, distinguished face with expressive eyes, a prominent nose, and neatly trimmed facial hair. The man's hair is wavy and reaches the nape of his neck. He wears a formal garment with a large white collar over a dark fabric, and a chain with a medallion around his neck. The oval-shaped frame around the portrait is inscribed with text. The background is plain with crosshatched shading.

artworks.title: Johannes Schade
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Hendrik Cornelisz van Vliet
artworks.description: The image is an upper-body portrait of a man seated in a chair. He is looking directly at the viewer with a slight expression of seriousness. The man has a mustache and neatly arranged hair beneath a cap. He is dressed in formal, historical attire with an ornate robe, wide collar, and braided embellishments on the sleeves. In his right hand, he holds an open book with visible text, on a table covered with a cloth. Beside him on the table, there are closed, leather-bound books stacked. To the left, there is a tall crucifix with an image of Jesus. The background is a plain patterned wall with architectural details, including a carved emblem on the paneling behind him.

artworks.title: Augustyn Bloemaert
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Johannes Cornelisz Verspronck
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated and looking to his right. He appears stern, with a strong jaw, pronounced cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a furrowed brow. He has short, thin hair, a receding hairline, and sideburns. The man wears a dark robe with a white collar and holds a long pipe in his right hand. On the table next to him are three large books, some bound with leather straps. A crucifix stands to the left of the books. The background is a neutral, textured surface.

artworks.title: Venus se plaint a Jupiter de la tempete que Junon a excitee contre Enee
artworks.artist: Henri Simon Thomassin after Elisabeth Sophie Cheron
artworks.description: The image shows three figures and a cherubic child within an ornate circular frame. In the center, an older man with a staff. To the left, a younger male figure wearing a winged helmet. To the right, a female figure with one arm extended towards the central man. The child clings to the female figure. The background is detailed with celestial motifs and an eagle at the bottom of the circle. A decorative border surrounds the scene, with text in French at the bottom.

artworks.title: Joseph Kneels with the Child before Mary on the Donkey
artworks.description: The image shows several human-like figures, including adults and children. The central figure is sitting on a donkey, wrapped in a long robe, with a halo above their head. Surrounding them are other individuals, some with wings. A smaller figure is looking up at the central person, possibly a child. The central figure has long hair beneath a veil, and the others have varying hairstyles and facial features. The individuals are dressed in different types of clothing, ranging from simple robes to more elaborate garments. There is someone reclined against a stone structure with a basket beside them, positioned to the right. The background includes textured surfaces, an arching detail, and dark, intricate lines for shading.

artworks.title: The Flight, Holy Family Walking with Angel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with an angel and a woman. The image has intricate detailing in strokes and shading characteristic of traditional etching techniques. Central to the composition is an angelic figure with broad wings, guiding an elderly person. To the right, a female figure stands draped in a flowing cloak, her expression contemplative. The background shows a landscape with trees and a distant hilly terrain under a vast sky, with swirling clouds suggesting an atmospheric depth. The drawing's style is reminiscent of the work of Salvator Rosa. The tone of the scene is serene yet imbued with a sense of narrative tension.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight, with Adoring Angels
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a group of figures, a donkey, a palm tree, and clouds. The scene depicts a gathering under a large palm tree dominating the left side of the image, with figures in various poses around it. A group of winged figures is present on the right side of the image. The artwork is rendered in fine lines, with intricate detailing in the clothing and foliage, against a background of open sky and clouds.

artworks.title: The Flight with Joseph in the Foreground
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with figures and a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is low, intersecting with a distant ridge and a town or village in the background. The etching style features fine lines and intricate detailing in clothing, trees, and animals. The color palette is black and white, enhancing the depth and texture of the scene. Sheep are being herded on a path, followed by figures on donkeys, possibly a family. Trees frame the scene on the right.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child at Left, with a File of Angels
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a bearded man with a halo walking next to a donkey carrying a basket. Winged figures are to the left under a tree. Birds are in the sky and the landscape includes hills and a body of water in the background. The linework and cross-hatching techniques create depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Arriving at a City Gate
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a crowded historical scene. The drawing features an architectural setting with large columns and an archway. A group of people are gathered closely together, depicted with intricate folds in their clothing and drapery. They seem to be engaged in an event or procession. A hanging lantern is visible under the archway, and in the foreground, a few figures are mounted on what appears to be a donkey or horse, carrying baskets. The composition is rich with textures, conveying the architectural elements and clothing with dense linework. The setting appears ancient or old-world, suggested by the styles of dress and the classical architecture. The scene captures a moment of bustling activity set against an imposing architectural backdrop.

artworks.title: Magician and Others Regarding a Serpent
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring several figures and a serpent. The composition showcases a group of figures engaged in an activity. Some figures are dressed in elaborate garments. They appear to be huddled together. In the foreground, a snake coils prominently. The background features rough textures and abstract elements. The drawing is rendered in fine, detailed lines.

artworks.title: Creation of the Universe
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of winged figures ascending amidst clouds. The scene shows figures in flowing garments and large wings. The central figure raises its arms upward, while the surrounding figures appear to be in motion. The composition utilizes loose, expressive lines, and the use of brown ink adds a sense of antiquity and drama to the image.

artworks.title: Capitulation of a Town
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in an interaction. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic sepia tone. The central focus is on a group of figures dressed in robes standing together. Some appear to be holding a large flat object. To the side stands a towering formation with an ornately detailed, draped fabric. The drawing's fluid lines and gentle wash of ink suggest movement and emphasize the dynamic posture of the figures.

artworks.title: Angelica and Medoro
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting in a serene setting. The figures are sketched using light and flowing lines. One figure appears to be reclining while the other leans over. The artist has employed a monochromatic palette, with variations in line weight and shading providing depth to the characters. Details such as clothing folds and the expression of the figures are marked with finesse. The position of the figures suggests a narrative interaction, with one seemingly supporting or aiding the other. The background is sketched with minimalistic lines.

artworks.title: The French Fireside
artworks.description: The image depicts three people in a room. In the center, a woman is seated on a chair with her legs crossed. She has fine features, voluminous curled hair, and wears a flowing gown. Next to her is a man leaning forward. Another man is seated across from the woman, handing her something. A third figure, a woman, reclines in the background. The room is richly decorated with ornate furniture, a grand fireplace, a large rug, and paneled walls.

artworks.title: Sir Philip Bowes Vere Broke
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He is turned slightly to his left, with his left hand resting on a cannon and his right hand holding a sword. The man has a composed expression, short wavy hair, and is dressed in a military uniform with ornate details. The background features cloudy patterns, a flag near the man's feet, and parts of a ship's rigging on the right side.

artworks.title: The Nativity and Passion of Christ
artworks.medium: woodcut printed from fifteen blocks on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing features various narrative scenes packed with characters, architecture, and text. There are rectangular panels displaying sequential scenes at the top. Lines lead to a hand surrounded by clouds or rays at a focal point. A larger central panel depicts a figure in front of an architectural setting, possibly a stable or barn, with beams of light. The sides show groups of figures, some in religious garb or holding symbolic objects. The bottom features detailed text, possibly scripted to provide context or narration for the scenes above.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with the Virgin and Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: The image shows three figures, with a central figure on a cross in a crucified position. The central figure is a man with a thin build, short hair, a beard, wearing a cloth around his waist, and a crown of thorns. His arms are outstretched, head tilted downward, and face strained. On the left is a person standing covered in flowing garments with a hooded cloak, looking down. On the right is another person standing in robes with curly hair and a beard, looking up. Both hold their robes. The background has hills, trees, and a distant building. Above the central figure is an inscribed sign "I.N.R.I." and vine leaves and fruit at the top corners of the frame. A skull is at the base of the cross in the landscape.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.artist: Joseph Mallord William Turner and J.C. Easling
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed still life with a central framed seascape. The drawing includes various items and motifs such as draped fabric, books, plants, and decorative objects. The top of the image features the title "LIBER STUDIORUM." The background includes architectural elements like arches.
